   i\int_{\partial\Sigma}\left(\chi_{(1,0)}\delta\psi^{(1,0)}+\chi_{(0,1)}\delta\psi^{(0,1)}\right).

Setting $\psi^{(1,0)}=0$ on the boundary cannot achieve this without leaving the boundary values of $\chi_{(1,0)}$ unconstrained, thereby violating ellipticity [8].
